en_how: A WebGL shader paints deep indigo-violet space fog with domain-warped fractal noise that pans with the camera; on top, Canvas does its own perspective projection of more than a thousand points scattered along three spiral arms, cyan for data and violet nodes and links for structure, all added with pre-drawn glow sprites; an amber octahedron at the centre is the recurring hero, the camera flies between keyframes, and three translucent glass cards (the frame behind blurred, then a tint) write the lines in turn.
